Name.description:
A variable, parameter or declared-function name.

Any text is a name; the kernel gives none of them meaning. Structural
validation refuses the empty name.

Site.description:
A node's address: the code it belongs to and the chain of
[`Node::children`] indexes that reaches it from that code's body.

A site is derived from the document and is never written by a host
(`K-ID-004`). An empty chain addresses the body itself.

edited.description:
An edit wrote the node itself: its statement, expression, action or
a name it holds. A node only moved, or changed only beneath, is not
edited.

from.description: Its site in the base document.

Unit.description: The code a node belongs to.

oneOf.description: A declared function of the document.
The kernel-code body of a library function.

description:
The nodes of one document that survive into another, each with the site
it has there (`K-EDIT-004`).

A node of `base` that is not listed did not survive. A node of `result`
that no entry leads to is new.

entries.description: Ordered by `from`; no two share a `from` or a `to`.

title: Correspondence
